data.name: Iqrar
data.gender_notes: Iqrar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who fulfills promises and commitments. The name Iqrar carries the meaning “Promise, Commitment” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Iqrar usually hope their child will grow to embody promise, commitment and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for the one who honors his commitments towards Allah and others, and strives to fulfill the promises he makes.
data.etymology: Iqrar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Promise, Commitment.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Iqrar total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: إقْرار
in_arabic.meaning: التأكيد على الإقرار، والتأكيد على الحقيقة، والتأكيد على الصدق
in_arabic.long_meaning: التسمية إقْرار هي تأكيد على الإقرار بالحقيقة، وتأكيد الصدق وصدق الكلمة، والإقرار بالواقع، والتأكيد على الصدق والصدق في القول والعمل، والإقرار بالحقيقة دون تكذيب أو كذب، والتأكيد على الصدق في كل ما هو قول أو عمل، والإقرار بالواقع دون تأخير أو تردد، والتأكيد على الصدق والصدق في كل ما هو قول أو عمل، والتأكيد على الصدق دون أي شكوك أو تردد، والإقرار بالحقيقة دون أي شكوك أو تردد، والتأكيد على الصدق والصدق في كل ما هو قول أو عمل، والتأكيد على الصدق دون أي شكوك أو تردد، والتأكيد على الصدق والصدق في كل ما هو قول أو عمل

in_urdu.name: اقرار
in_urdu.meaning: امضا دینا، صدق کا تقرر، حق کا اعتراف
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام اقرار سے علم دینے والوں میں یہ نام زیادہ تر اس لیے لگایا جاتا ہے کہ اس نام میں صدق اور حق کا تقرر ہے، یہ نام اس لیے بھی لگایا جاتا ہے کہ یہ نام صاف اور سچا ہوتا ہے، اور یہ نام اس لیے لگایا جاتا ہے کہ یہ نام ایمانداروں کا نام ہوتا ہے، اور یہ نام اس لیے بھی لگایا جاتا ہے کہ یہ نام حق کی طرف ہوتا ہے، اور یہ نام اس لیے لگایا جاتا ہے کہ یہ نام ایمانداروں کا نام ہوتا ہے

in_hindi.name: इक्रार
in_hindi.meaning: सत्य का प्रमाण, सही की पुष्टि, सच्चाई का प्रमाण
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम इक्रार का अर्थ है सत्य का प्रमाण, सही की पुष्टि, सच्चाई का प्रमाण, और इस नाम का उपयोग भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में किया जाता है, जो इस नाम के अर्थ को समझता है कि यह नाम सच्चाई और ईमानदारी का प्रतीक है, और यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में भी महत्वपूर्ण माना जाता है, जो इस नाम को ईमानदारी और सच्चाई का प्रतीक मानता है

in_english.name: Iqrar
in_english.long_meaning: The name Iqrar is derived from the Arabic root qr-r, which means to confirm, verify, or acknowledge. In Islamic tradition, Iqrar is associated with the affirmation of truth, sincerity, and honesty. Those who bear this name are known for their integrity, reliability, and strong moral character. The name Iqrar is also found in various Islamic texts, including the Quran, where it is used to describe the affirmation of truth and the rejection of falsehood

data.cultural_impact: The name Iqrar carries a significant cultural impact in the Islamic community. In a world where trust and commitment are crucial for building strong relationships and communities, the name highlights the importance of fulfilling promises. In Islamic teachings, actions speak louder than words, and keeping promises is considered a noble virtue. Thus, Iqrar provides a powerful reminder to honor our commitments and live up to our words, not just for the sake of reputation, but for the sake of moral character and respect within the community. It also serves as a subtle yet impactful call to action for individuals who may need motivation to honor their promises and commitments.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Iqrar holds significant spiritual significance in the Islamic tradition. It represents the essence of Taqwa (God-consciousness) and Tawakkul (trust in God). Fulfilling promises is not only an outward expression of character but an inward journey of self-discipline, self-control, and faith in God's plan. By keeping our promises, we demonstrate reliance on God, trusting that He will provide us with the means to fulfill them. Furthermore, honoring our commitments to others is an act of worship, contributing to the greater good of society and ultimately, pleasing Allah (SWT). Thus, the name Iqrar serves as a constant reminder of the importance of accountability to oneself and others, and the rewards that come from living up to our words and making good on our promises.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Promise, Commitment" symbolizes The one who fulfills promises and commitments. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Iqrar serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of promise, commitment.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Iqrar was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and is mentioned in Sahih Bukhari. The name Iqrar carried significant weight in that era.
